Vaughan David Investments Inc. IL trimmed its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.9% in the third quarter, HoldingsChannel.com reports. The firm owned 10,340 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 648 shares during the period. Vaughan David Investments Inc. IL’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,594,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.

Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $176.21 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. The firm has a market capitalization of $900,270.00, a P/E ratio of 17.24, a P/E/G ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.22. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $137.05 and a 1-year high of $180.62. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the previous year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
The firm also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th were issued a dividend of $0.63 per share. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.43%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. Apple’s payout ratio is presently 24.66%. 
A number of analysts recently commented on AAPL shares. KeyCorp reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $192.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, November 3rd. Canaccord Genuity reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $195.00 price objective (up from $180.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, November 3rd. Morgan Stanley set a $200.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, November 3rd. Nomura set a $185.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, November 3rd. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein set a $195.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, November 3rd. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-four have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.58.

Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
